title: Pushforward along a closed immersion
statement:
Let $i:Z\to X$ be a
closed immersion of
schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. The functor $i_*:\Ab(Z_{\Et})\to\Ab(X_{\Et})$ of
[def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is fully faithful, $i^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is a
left inverse, and the essential image consists of those abelian sheaves $F$
on $X_{\Et}$ whose support is contained in $Z$, that is, with $F_{\bar x}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] for every geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over a point of $X\setminus Z$. (For $X$ of finite type over a field this is the condition $\kunsupp F\subseteq Z$ of [def-kun-support].)

proof.text: For an etale $V\to X$ one has $(i_*F)(V)=F(V\times_XZ)$ by [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. The closed-immersion full-faithfulness proposition [prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful] gives an isomorphism $i^{-1}i_*F\cong F$, so $i^{-1}$ is a left inverse and $i_*$ is fully faithful. Every object of the essential image has support in $Z$: for $G\in\Ab(Z_{\Et})$ and $\bar x$ lying over a point of $X\setminus Z$, the open complement $X\setminus Z$ gives a cofinal system of pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar x$ with $V\to X$ factoring through $X\setminus Z$ (replace $V$ by its open subscheme $V\times_X(X\setminus Z)$, which contains $\bar v$), and for these $V\times_XZ=\varnothing$, so $(i_*G)(V)=G(\varnothing)=0$ and $(i_*G)_{\bar x}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]; an isomorphism of sheaves induces isomorphisms of stalks, so the same holds for every sheaf isomorphic to $i_*G$. Conversely, let $F$ be a sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ with support contained in $Z$ and consider the canonical unit map $\eta:F\to i_*i^{-1}F$. If $\bar x$ lies over a point of $Z$, write $\bar x=i\circ\bar z$. The stalk comparison for inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] identifies $(i^{-1}F)_{\bar z}$ with $F_{\bar x}$, while [lemma-openclosed-stalk-lowerstar] identifies $(i_*i^{-1}F)_{\bar x}$ with $(i^{-1}F)_{\bar z}$; the unit induces the identity under these identifications. If $\bar x$ lies over $X\setminus Z$, then $(i_*i^{-1}F)_{\bar x}=0$ by the previous paragraph's computation with $G=i^{-1}F$, and $F_{\bar x}=0$ by the support hypothesis. Thus $\eta$ is an isomorphism at every geometric stalk, hence an isomorphism by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative].

split_report.summary: Replaced the imported paragraph with a complete stalkwise proof. The direct-image definition and the existing closed-immersion full-faithfulness proposition give the left-inverse claim; the essential-image converse is proved from the inverse-image stalk comparison, closed-immersion stalk cofinality, the support definition, and stalk conservativity. The incorrect claim that an etale neighbourhood of Z extends by composing with i was removed.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the blueprint proof paragraph: restriction of i_* and the stalkwise characterization of sheaves supported on Z.

tool_uses.why: The essential-image stalk calculation needs the generic inverse-image stalk comparison, which is filed in the proper-base-change unit and is not supplied by this unit's route.
